verdict.rationale: Reflect's own pages say note contents are end-to-end encrypted and that "no one else can read them (not even us)." The API docs confirm the servers can't read note contents, and community posts mention a security audit and the founder reaffirming E2E encryption. Notes are stored on Reflect's servers and there is an iOS app alongside the web and browser tools, which implies cross-device sync. However, files and images you upload are not E2E encrypted. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the multi-device sync service, E2E coverage of attachments/files, independent technical verification of the encryption model.
